verses.ar: مَزْمُورٌ لِدَاوُدَ قَدِّمُوا لِلرَّبِّ يَا أَبْنَاءَ ٱللهِ، قَدِّمُوا لِلرَّبِّ مَجْدًا وَعِزًّا.
verses.kjv: A Psalm of David. Give unto the LORD, O ye mighty, give unto the LORD glory and strength.
verses.web: A Psalm by David. Ascribe to Yahweh, you sons of the mighty, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength.

verses.ar: قَدِّمُوا لِلرَّبِّ مَجْدَ ٱسْمِهِ. ٱسْجُدُوا لِلرَّبِّ فِي زِينَةٍ مُقَدَّسَةٍ.
verses.kjv: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name; worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.
verses.web: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Worship Yahweh in holy array.

verses.ar: صَوْتُ ٱلرَّبِّ عَلَى ٱلْمِيَاهِ. إِلَهُ ٱلْمَجْدِ أَرْعَدَ. ٱلرَّبُّ فَوْقَ ٱلْمِيَاهِ ٱلْكَثِيرَةِ.
verses.kjv: The voice of the LORD [is] upon the waters: the God of glory thundereth: the LORD [is] upon many waters.
verses.web: Yahweh’s voice is on the waters. The God of glory thunders, even Yahweh on many waters.

verses.ar: صَوْتُ ٱلرَّبِّ بِٱلْقُوَّةِ. صَوْتُ ٱلرَّبِّ بِٱلْجَلَالِ.
verses.kjv: The voice of the LORD [is] powerful; the voice of the LORD [is] full of majesty.
verses.web: Yahweh’s voice is powerful. Yahweh’s voice is full of majesty.

verses.ar: صَوْتُ ٱلرَّبِّ مُكَسِّرُ ٱلْأَرْزِ، وَيُكَسِّرُ ٱلرَّبُّ أَرْزَ لُبْنَانَ
verses.kjv: The voice of the LORD breaketh the cedars; yea, the LORD breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.web: Yahweh’s voice breaks the cedars. Yes, Yahweh breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.

verses.ar: وَيُمْرِحُهَا مِثْلَ عِجْلٍ. لُبْنَانَ وَسِرْيُونَ مِثْلَ فَرِيرِ ٱلْبَقَرِ ٱلْوَحْشِيِّ.
verses.kjv: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.
verses.web: He makes them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young, wild ox.

verses.kjv: The voice of the LORD divideth the flames of fire.
verses.web: Yahweh’s voice strikes with flashes of lightning.

verses.ar: صَوْتُ ٱلرَّبِّ يُزَلْزِلُ ٱلْبَرِّيَّةَ. يُزَلْزِلُ ٱلرَّبُّ بَرِيَّةَ قَادِشَ.
verses.kjv: The voice of the LORD shaketh the wilderness; the LORD shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.
verses.web: Yahweh’s voice shakes the wilderness. Yahweh shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.

verses.ar: صَوْتُ ٱلرَّبِّ يُوَلِّدُ ٱلْإِيَّلَ، وَيَكْشِفُ ٱلْوُعُورَ، وَفِي هَيْكَلِهِ ٱلْكُلُّ قَائِلٌ: «مَجْدٌ».
verses.kjv: The voice of the LORD maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests: and in his temple doth every one speak of [his] glory.
verses.web: Yahweh’s voice makes the deer calve, and strips the forests bare. In his temple everything says, “Glory!”

verses.ar: ٱلرَّبُّ بِٱلطُّوفَانِ جَلَسَ، وَيَجْلِسُ ٱلرَّبُّ مَلِكًا إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ.
verses.kjv: The LORD sitteth upon the flood; yea, the LORD sitteth King for ever.
verses.web: Yahweh sat enthroned at the Flood. Yes, Yahweh sits as King forever.

verses.ar: ٱلرَّبُّ يُعْطِي عِزًّا لِشَعْبِهِ. ٱلرَّبُّ يُبَارِكُ شَعْبَهُ بِٱلسَّلَامِ.
verses.kjv: The LORD will give strength unto his people; the LORD will bless his people with peace.
verses.web: Yahweh will give strength to his people. Yahweh will bless his people with peace.
